topAction: Keep environmental humidity low and prepare for final plain water flush as buds finish swelling.
fixSteps: Lower indoor relative humidity to 40-45% to protect dense colas against mold or bud rot.
Gradually reduce nitrogen feeding as the plant naturally finishes and uses up stored mobile nutrients.
Monitor trichomes on the calyxes (not sugar leaves) using a jeweler's loupe or digital microscope.
preventionTips: Ensure steady airflow with oscillating fans around the main colas without blowing directly on buds at high speed.
Avoid overwatering as water uptake naturally slows down in the final weeks of flowering.
environmentSummary: Optimal Climate (Maintain low humidity for late flower)
